PlaySound(soundKitID:number) — Ascension's native PlaySound accepts numeric SoundKit ids from the SOUNDKIT table (SharedOverwrites.lua:17 wraps it); stock 3.3.5a PlaySound takes a string sound name. Every click/tab sound in this addon goes through it.

SetCVar/GetCVar on the custom CVars caLastClass, caLastSpec, previewCharacterAdvancementChanges, HelpTipBitfield — registered via C_CVar.RegisterSavedCharacterCVar / RegisterSavedCVar (GameCVars.lua:61,62,79,114); on stock they must be RegisterCVar'd before use or Get returns nil.

GetItemCount(itemID) is expected to report Ability Essence (383080) / Talent Essence (383081) / Mark of Ascension (375250) / Scroll of Unlearning (1101243) balances — these are real item ids in Ascension's item_template; the essence budget the shim serves must be reflected by GetItemCount or the totals show 0.
Button:SetNormalAtlas / Button:SetHighlightAtlas are native widget methods on the Ascension client (no Lua definition anywhere in the tree; used by 55 files); stock buttons lack them.
SetPortraitToTexture(texture, path) (stock) is relied on through Texture:SetPortraitTexture; SetPortraitTexture(texture, unit) also stock.

IsSpellKnown(spellID) and GetSpellInfo(spellID) are used with stock signatures; GetSpellInfo is pcall-wrapped because Ascension's client raises for unknown spell ids (CASpellButton.lua:207) — a stock client returns nil instead, which the code also handles.
GetUnspentTalentPoints(false, true) and GetNumTalents(1, false, true) use the stock (inspect, pet) argument order; HasPetUI()/PetCanBeAbandoned() stock.

ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS[q], RAID_CLASS_COLORS[token], DISABLED_FONT_COLOR etc. are expected to be ColorPrototype objects with :WrapText and :GetRGB (SharedXML/Util/ColorUtil.lua), and RAID_CLASS_COLORS/LOCALIZED_CLASS_NAMES_MALE must contain every token in CHARACTER_ADVANCEMENT_CLASS_ORDER (only the 10 stock classes for this addon).

Frame:SetShown, Region:ClearAndSetPoint, Texture:SetAtlas, string.isNilOrEmpty, math.clamp are metatable/library extensions from SharedXML/TypeExtensions (pure Lua, ship verbatim); string.trim / strtrim is a stock built-in.

SearchBoxTemplate, UIDropDownMenuTemplate, UIPanelScrollFrameTemplate, UIPanelCloseButton come from Ascension's SharedXML copies (SharedPanelTemplates.xml, UIDropDownMenuTemplates.xml, Scroll/ScrollFrame.xml); SearchBoxTemplate does not exist in stock 3.3.5a FrameXML.

UIPanelWindows["Collections"] needs the Ascension-only key dontCloseForNonCenterPanels (UIParent.lua:57, honoured at UIParent.lua:2033) — stock ShowUIPanel would close Collections when other center panels open.

Stock ones used: ACHIEVEMENT_SUMMARY_CATEGORY, TALENT_SPEC_PET_PRIMARY, LEVEL, SPELL_REQUIRED_FORM, ITEM_QUALITY1..5_DESC, TALENTS, ABILITIES.

CharacterAdvancement entry records (DBFilesClient_CharacterAdvancement.dbc / advancement.tsv): fields read by this addon: ID, Name, Icon (file name without path), Type ("Ability"|"Talent"|"TalentAbility"|mastery), Spells (array of rank spellIDs, index = rank), RequiredLevel, Class (DBC class name e.g. "Druid"/"Hero"), Tab (DBC spec name e.g. "Balance"), Row (0-based), Column (1-based), TECost, Masteries, Flags, Group (transitively).

CharacterAdvancementClassTypes.dbc / CharacterAdvancementTabTypes.dbc: the class/spec DBC names used as keys for GetTalentsByClass/GetSpellsByClass/GetLearnedTE/AE, mapped from tokens by CharacterAdvancementUtil.ClassConversions (with the Reborn* rename for default classes).
CharacterAdvancementCategories.dbc (browser): categoryID list plus (reqLevel, name, icon, description, staggerFlag) per category; ids 31-52 are WildCard-hidden.
SpellTagTypes.dbc / SpellTags.dbc: root tag types, child tag types and display names for the browser filter dropdown; per-entry tags for SetFilteredEntriesByCategory.
CharacterAdvancementEssence.dbc: essence budgets per level (only reached indirectly through C_BuildEditor.GetEssenceForLevel and GetItemCount of the essence items).
ChrSpecs.dbc / ChrClasses.dbc: C_ClassInfo.GetSpecInfo(classToken, specToken).Name for the three spec tabs of each stock class.
Primary-stat entries 1149 (Strength), 1150 (Agility), 1151 (Intellect), 1152 (Spirit) must exist as CA entries (C_PrimaryStat.internalIds) whenever the character is HERO.

Server config keys via C_Config.GetBoolConfig: CONFIG_WILDCARD_QUICK_ROLLING_ENABLED, CONFIG_ABILITY_BROWSER_ENABLED, CONFIG_LEGACY_CHARACTER_ADVANCEMENT_ENABLED (nil/true selects this Season9 addon).

protected_actions: None that stock secure-code rules block: no CastSpellByID/PickupSpell(stock)/SetBinding/RunMacro calls. Details worth knowing:

C_CharacterAdvancement.PickupSpell(entryID) (CASpellButton.lua:281, OnDragStart) puts a spell on the cursor; the stock equivalent PickupSpell(spellID) is callable from insecure code in 3.3.5a, so a shim can map entry -> Spells[rank].
Internal_CopyToClipboard(url) (CharacterAdvancement.xml:149) has no stock equivalent at all (clipboard write is impossible from Lua); replace with a StaticPopup EditBox holding the URL.

SendChatMessage(".ca2 player addentry|removeentry <name> <entryID>") (CharacterAdvancement.lua:1301,1310) is GM-only and unprotected; the shim's server module would need to accept those commands or the items should stay hidden (C_AccountInfo.IsGM() false).
HideUIPanel(Collections)/ShowUIPanel via Collections:GoToTab and ToggleTalentFrame() are unprotected out of combat; CollectionsMixin:PLAYER_REGEN_DISABLED hides the panel in combat.

notes: SCOPE: this is the 'legacy'/Season 9 CA panel for the ten stock classes (and HERO/free-pick heroes) — UIParent.CharacterAdvancement_LoadUI only loads it when the character is neither a custom CoA class (-> Ascension_CoATalents) nor a 'default class' (-> Ascension_CharacterAdvancement), and CONFIG_LEGACY_CHARACTER_ADVANCEMENT_ENABLED is nil/true. All three addons define the SAME global frame name 'CharacterAdvancement' parented to Collections, so only one may be loaded per session; the shim must reproduce the loader decision (and the LoadAddOn rewrite in GlobalOverwrites.lua:473). LAYOUT MODEL: spells are a 3-column grid by array index (GetSpellsByClass order is display order); talents are placed by entry.Row/entry.Column (x=-102+(Column-1)*68, y=42+Row*44) under ScrollChild.Talents; the SUMMARY tab uses GetKnownSpellEntries/GetKnownTalentEntries by index. The talent-gate system (CA_TIER_GATES, GatePool) is dead code: CharacterAdvancementUtil.AreTalentGatesEnabled() is `CA_USE_GATES_DEBUG and ...` and CA_USE_GATES_DEBUG=false at line 2. CLASS KEYS: the UI works in class TOKENS (DRUID) for CVars/tabs/atlases but calls the C_CharacterAdvancement class-scoped natives with DBC NAMES ('Druid','Balance') from CharacterAdvancementUtil.ClassConversions; for default classes the map is renamed to RebornDruid etc. (that addon path is not this one). MODES: self.mode from Enum.GameMode; WildCard hides the footer and gates, Draft hides the loadout tab, BuildDraft hides the footer and primary stats; a first release can serve GetCustomGameMode()=0 and skip C_Wildcard/C_BuildEditor/DraftUtil entirely as long as the namespaces exist (BuildCreatorUtil.IsPickingSpells() is pure Lua state and stays false). REFRESH CONTRACT: after any learn/unlearn/lock the ONLY redraw trigger is the CHARACTER_ADVANCEMENT_PENDING_BUILD_UPDATED frame event (registered by the main frame AND by every pooled button while shown) plus LOCK/UNLOCK_ENTRY_RESULT(result, entryID); essence totals refresh on BAG_UPDATE/CURRENCY_DISPLAY_UPDATE through stock GetItemCount(383080/383081), so the shim must either fake those item counts or override GetItemCount for the essence ids. The Wire-protocol RESULT/ESSENCE/KNOWN replies from DESIGN.md §5 should therefore end by firing CHARACTER_ADVANCEMENT_PENDING_BUILD_UPDATED through the EventBus. CanLearnID/CanUnlearnID reasons are global-string KEYS (Enum.CALearnResult values like 'CA_LEARN_LOW_LEVEL') resolved with _G[reason]; the sentinel Enum.CALearnResult.DisplayEntry marks trainer-only display entries (drawn translucent, mouse disabled). GetTalentRankByID returns (rank, maxRank); rank selects entry.Spells[rank] as the tooltip/link spell. NIL-UNSAFE CALLS the shim must satisfy: C_ClassInfo.GetSpecInfo(...).Name for every (class, spec) in CHARACTER_ADVANCEMENT_CLASS_SPEC_ORDER; GetEntryByInternalID(1149..1152) for heroes; ipairs/pairs over GetTalentsByClass/GetSpellsByClass/GetKnownSpellEntries/GetKnownTalentEntries/GetRootSpellTagTypes/GetCategories (return empty tables, never nil); GetCategoryDisplayInfo must return a numeric reqLevel for every category id. HIDDEN DEPENDENCIES: MagicButton_OnLoad lives in the AscensionUI ADDON, and the SpellTagFrame shadow texture in AwAddons — both outside the toc's Ascension_Collections dependency; the sidebar lists need FrameXML SpellListItem.xml/SpecListItem.xml/LoadoutListItem.xml + CurrencyBar.xml + IconSelectorFrame.xml + UIPanelTemplates.xml (AnimatedRankTemplate, RarityGemContainerTemplate, UINewSpellRankIndicator, CollapsibleHeaderTemplate) and MainMenuBarMicroButtons.xml (DraftModeMicroButtonTemplate) from Ascension's FrameXML, plus the SharedXML set (SharedPanelTemplates, SharedTemplates, Scroll/*, TabSystem/*, FilterDropDown, UIDropDownMenuTemplates, Pools, Mixin, FunctionUtil, Util, CallbackRegistryMixin, HelpTip, AtlasInfo, Enum, Const, ColorUtil, SoundKit, TypeExtensions). GLOBALSTRINGS: none of the ~90 custom strings are in Lua — they come from the patched GlobalStrings.dbc; missing ones only degrade to nil text except CA_TALENTS_UNLOCK_AT_LEVEL and the CA_BROWSER_* which have inline fallbacks. NATIVE WIDGET METHODS with no Lua fallback: Button:SetNormalAtlas/SetHighlightAtlas (implement via AtlasUtil:Unpack + SetNormalTexture/SetHighlightTexture + GetNormalTexture():SetTexCoord in the shim's Button metatable). PlaySound is called with NUMERIC SoundKit ids through SharedOverwrites' wrapper; the shim's copy must translate or drop them. CVars caLastClass/caLastSpec/previewCharacterAdvancementChanges/HelpTipBitfield must be RegisterCVar'd (GameCVars.lua) before OnLoad — OnLoad writes previewCharacterAdvancementChanges='0'. GetSpellInfo is pcall-wrapped (line 207) because Ascension's client throws on unknown ids; broken entries are reported to chat once per spellID. Reference inventories cross-checked: api-surface.tsv + ext-lua-bindings.tsv agree with the code for every C_* member here; C_Player, C_GameMode, C_CVar.Get/Set, C_PrimaryStat are pure Lua (FrameXML/Util, SharedXML/Util) over the natives GetCustomGameMode, GetCVar/SetCVar, UnitClassBase, C_Aura.UnitHasAura; C_CharacterAdvancement.CanLearnID/CanUnlearnID/GetQualityInfo (and the *Investment getters not used here) are Lua wrappers over same-named natives in GlobalOverwrites.lua:361-400. Also read for cross-checking (not part of the addon): DESIGN.md §3-5, FrameXML/Util/{CharacterAdvancementUtil,BuildCreatorUtil,SpecializationUtil,TalentLoadoutUtil,DraftUtil,TokenUtil,C_Player,C_GameMode,C_PrimaryStat,GlobalOverwrites,GlobalFunctions}.lua, FrameXML/{UIParent,Constants,GameCVars,HelpTips,StaticPopup,SpellListItem,CurrencyBar}.lua, SharedXML/{SharedConstants,SharedTemplates,SharedPanelTemplates,Enum,HelpTip,AtlasInfo}.lua, SharedXML/Util/{C_CVar,Const,ColorUtil,HyperlinkUtil,SharedOverwrites,SoundKit,Mixin}.lua, SharedXML/TypeExtensions/{Region,Texture,Button,string,math}.lua, AddOns/Ascension_Collections/Collections.lua, MainMenuBarMicroButtons.xml.
